text.p: Lithuanian newspapers carried the following reports in their Thursday editions. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Confederation of Lithuanian Industrialists is to draw up a foreign trade strategy.
- Prime Minister-designate Gediminas Vagnorius said the number of ministries will be cut to 16 from 19 and the ministry of industry and trade and the ministry of economy will be eliminated.
- Timber auctions were resumed on Wednesday in Lithuania after a 50 year gap.
- Lithuanian President Algirdas Brazauskas recalled Lithuania's ambassador in Ukraine, Romualdas Ramoska. Romaska is alleged to have forged documents.
- If the salaries of health professionals are not increased before November 24 the Lithuanian Doctors Union intends to launch a nationwide strike.
- Klaipeda city council has protested against the decision of the Lithuanian government to give border police 2.4 hectares for a port gate check point on the Kursiu Nerija spit.
